title: Taming the Centaur(s) with LAPITHS: a framework for a theoretically grounded interpretation of AI performances
abstract: arXiv:2604.27927v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce a framework called LAPITHS (Language model Analysis through Paradigm grounded Interpretations of Theses about Human likenesS) and use it to show that several major claims advanced by models such as CENTAUR, proposed as an artificial Unified Model of Cognition, are not theoretically or empirically justified. LAPITHS provides a principled reference point for counteracting the current behaviouristic tendency in AI research to interpret the human level performances of transformer based language models as evidence of human like underlying computation and, by extension, as signs of cognitive abilities. translated_title: 用LAPITHS驯服半人马：一个为AI表现提供理论依据解释的框架
translated_abstract: 我们引入了一个名为LAPITHS（通过基于范式的类人性论点解释来分析语言模型）的框架，并用它来表明，诸如CENTAUR等被提议作为人工统一认知模型的系统所提出的多项主要论断，在理论和经验上都缺乏充分依据。LAPITHS提供了一个有原则的参照点，用以对抗当前AI研究中的一种行为主义倾向，即将基于Transformer的语言模型达到人类水平的表现解读为类人底层计算的证据，进而解读为认知能力的标志。LAPITHS的新颖之处在于明确阐述了基于两项定量评估的论证：(i) 最小认知网格，这是一种有理论依据的方法，用于估计人工系统的认知合理性；(ii) 一项行为比较，表明与CENTAUR类模型所报告的类似结果（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出LAPITHS框架，通过最小认知网格和行为比较两项定量评估，论证CENTAUR等模型的人类水平表现并不能证明其具备类人的底层计算或真正的认知能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LAPITHS, a framework that uses the Minimal Cognitive Grid and behavioural comparisons to show that human-level performances of models like CENTAUR do not justify claims of human-like underlying computation or cognitive abilities.
